To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) a deep learning implementation of the CSP method is possible, (2) the deep learning method is more efficient than the original CSP method, (3) the deep learning approach is robust and generalizes well to unseen data and (4) the method can be easily extended to spatio-temporally filter the data
we present a novel neural network model that is able to extract CSP-like spatial filters and can be trained to classify motor imagery data with high performance.

the proposed method, Csp-NN, is able to outperform CSP and SVM in a binary motor imagery classification task, with a classification rate of 0.93, while being faster to train and having a lower number of hyperparameters to tune.
